title: Would love feedback on my cozy casino resort simulator
author: TheGrowthYardGaming
selftext:
This was made using Opus and Fable. It's still very early in dev but I have been working 5+ hours every single day on this for the past 3 months. AI really does the heavy lifting. This would simply take me too long to build by myself before I had claude code.

  
Any feedback is truly appreciated. There are quite a few bugs and multiplayer was only added yesterday so it will beed a lot of work. I want to redo all the text and menu UI. Anyways I will let you be the judge. I have fun when I test this but I would say it's only 30-40% complete.
